packages.name: Daily Games
packages.description: Daily puzzles designed for e-ink: NYT Wordle, Connections, Strands, Mini and Daily Crossword, The Atlantic crossword, Krillion, FoodGuessr (plus Cuisine Match and Plate-Off), Costcodle, WhereTaken, More/Less, Marveldle and Brandle, with endless modes, plus Sabacc: an offline Corellian Spike card game against three computer players. Adds itself to the ZenOS App Launcher.
packages.author: helloparthshah
